review.statusNote: The original foundation and upper masters remain unchanged and are verified by their SHA-256 and Git blob hashes above. Exporter and sync repeatability matched 1,178 files with no changes, additions, or removals; 12 previously repaired-house/L30 PNGs remained byte-identical. The 114-case frontend suite, focused browser checks, production build, typecheck, and cache canvas disposal check passed. Normal/planning/focus scenes are accepted at north orientation, canonical 6x5m footprint, 1366x768 and 390x844, DPR1 normal quality. Desktop fallback is accepted at 1366x768 DPR1 default auto quality; effective quality was not captured. The mobile fallback screenshot and other DPR/quality settings are not reviewed. Filtered SVG ground shadow uses transparent Canvas2D decoding retained as Pixi CanvasSource; one RGBA reservation remains and the PNG pipeline is unchanged. A gold shape/overlay is visible in the native-background QA capture and is not part of Tomb source artwork; its exact identity remains unresolved, and no art change is based on it.
